name: JW Marriott Absheron Baku
positioning: Wellness-minded luxury hotel on Azadliq Square in central Baku, with a high-floor spa and pool looking over the city and the Caspian Sea
best_for: Travelers who want a central base near Baku Boulevard and Government House
Guests who want a spa and indoor pool with city and sea views
Families, with a garden treasure hunt for children

facts.text: The hotel is on Azadliq Square, near Baku Boulevard, Government House and Neftchilar Avenue.
The baroque-style Government House is just opposite the hotel.
The Sharq Zali Ballroom has floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of the Caspian Sea and Baku's skyline.
Rooms have marble bathrooms with luxury bath products.
The Presidential Suite has a sea view and a balcony.
Absheron Spa has a treatment room designed for couple treatments, a steam room and a Finnish sauna.
The gym offers panoramic views from the 23rd floor.
The JW Garden includes an herb garden with mint, chili and basil, and a cozy lounge area with comfortable swings.
Fireworks Urban Kitchen is a steakhouse with a city view and a spacious outdoor terrace with fire bowls.
The Tea Lounge offers a taste of Baku's local tea ceremony with pastries.
Children can solve riddles and uncover hidden treasures in the JW Garden.
The concierge team can help guests explore the historic Old City on foot or arrange a guided transfer to the Fire Temple.

highlights.text: Absheron Spa is on the 21st floor, with views of Baku city and the Caspian Sea.
The top-floor heated indoor pool has a jacuzzi and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Every room has a view, of the Caspian Sea or of the city.
The Badikube in the lobby, inspired by the Baku wind, holds a library of Azerbaijani books.
The JW Garden has an herb garden and a lounge area with swings.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 23.2 km from Heydar Aliyev International Airport.
The hotel sits within the urban buzz of the city's business district.
WhataHotel notes a business-focused atmosphere that may feel formal for leisure travelers.
